exposure: gestational diabetes mellitus diagnosis by New Zealand Society for the Study of Diabetes criteria
gestational diabetes mellitus diagnosis by modified International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups criteria
outcome: characteristics of women with gestational diabetes mellitus
cohort: 6376 women who delivered at Counties Manukau District Health Board (CMDHB) over a 12-month period
finding: Adopting the modified International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups criteria for diagnosing gestational diabetes mellitus would increase prevalence by 62% and lead to a higher mean birthweight compared to the New Zealand Society for the Study of Diabetes criteria, but similar pregnancy outcomes overall.
